name: Kozy Shack All Natural Original Rice Pudding
whyItWorks: Simmered white rice in sweet milk and eggs creates a comforting, low-residue dessert. White rice provides easily absorbed complex carbs and soothing bulk.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy chilled or warm up in the microwave for 20 seconds. Take a lactase pill if sensitive.
watchOuts: Contains whole milk; ensure cooked rice grains are tender.
